title: Massons Trichrome Staining Protocol
author: Jennifer Rutkowsky
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.56mg9c6

steps.title: Fix in Bouins Solution
steps.instruction: Place samples in Bouins for one hour in a 55 degree oven, or overnight at room temperature if needed.

steps.title: Wash Samples
steps.instruction: Wash well in running water until the yellow color is gone.

steps.title: Stain with Weigerts Hematoxylin
steps.instruction: Stain in Weigerts Hematoxylin for 10-20 minutes.

steps.title: Rinse Samples
steps.instruction: Wash well in running water for 10 minutes, then rinse with distilled water.

steps.title: Stain with Biebrich Scarlet-Acid Fuchsin
steps.instruction: Place slides in Biebrich Scarlet-Acid Fuchsin for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Treat with Phosphomolybdic-Phosphotungstic Acid
steps.instruction: Place slides in the Phosphomolybdic-Phosphotungstic Acid Solution in a plastic coplin jar and process in the Bio Rad for 25 seconds using the total time setting.

substeps.instruction: Let stand for 30 seconds after processing.

steps.title: Stain with Aniline Blue
steps.instruction: Place slides in Aniline Blue solution for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Optional Acetic Acid Treatment
steps.instruction: Place in 1% Acetic acid for 3 minutes if desired.
